description: This file defines a class for generating financial reports in the Odoo framework, including methods for loading account data and setting report variables.

classes.name: base_report
classes.description: A report parser class for French localization financial reports in Odoo.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and sets up local context variables.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Loads fiscal year and period data, and initiates account data loading based on report name.

methods.name: _set_variable
methods.description: Sets a variable in the local context.

methods.name: _get_variable
methods.description: Retrieves a variable from the local context.

methods.name: _load_accounts
methods.description: Calculates account balances based on account codes, definitions, and fiscal year status.
